_comment: The VS Code extension host loads CommonJS, not ESM — this is the one
place in the repo that is not ESM, and it is not negotiable.
moduleResolution is Bundler because esbuild resolves the imports, not
node: the removed node10 mode is what TypeScript 7 rejects, and Bundler
is the mode that matches how this code is actually built. Imports
still carry the .js extension: the tests compile under NodeNext, and
Bundler resolves ./x.js to x.ts as well.
